4.title: Om
4.meaning: The ‘soham’ mantra is repeated with our every breath. The second sound in 'so', i.e., 'o' and the second sound in 'ham', 'm' together constitute 'om'. This soham is repeatedly chanted in all the three states; waking, dream and deep sleep. The entire alphabet is formed out of the mother of letters, the primal sound 'OM'.

8.title: Gayathri Mantra
8.meaning: That which Permeates the three worlds – Body, Mind and Soul. We Meditate on this Most Venerable Self Effulgence. And Pray for the Enlightenment of our Intellect.
8.lyrics:
Aum Bhoor Bhuvah Suvah

Tat Savithur Varenyam

Bhargo Devasya Dheemahi

Dhiyo Yonah Prachodayaat

9.title: Namo Tassa Bhagavato
9.meaning:
I seek refuge in the Buddha
I seek refuge in Dharma (Righteousness)
I seek refuge in Sangha (Holy order/Community)
9.lyrics:
Namo Tassa Bhagavato Arahato Samma Sambuddhassa
Buddham Sharanam Gatchami
Dhammam Sharanam Gatchami
Sangham Sharanam Gatchami

10.title: Ashem Vohu Vahishtem Asti
10.meaning:
Righteousness is the best good (and it) is happiness
Happiness(is) to him, who is righteous
For the sake of the best righteousness
10.lyrics:
Ashem Vohu Vahishtem Asti

Ushta Asti Ushta Ahmai

Hyat Ashai Vahishtai Ashem

11.title: Sch’ma Yisrael
11.meaning: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord
11.lyrics:
Sch’ma Yisrael, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai Echad

Adonai Echad (2)

12.title: Bismillah Ar-Rahman
12.meaning:
In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
There is Only One God.
12.lyrics:
Bismillah Ar-Rahman Ar-Raheem (3)

La Ilaha illallah Allah Allah (3)

13.title: Our Father who Art in Heaven
13.lyrics:
Our Father who Art in Heaven hallowed be Thy name
Thy kingdom come Thy will be done on Earth as it is in Heaven
Give us this day our daily bread and forgive us our trespasses
As we forgive those who trespass against us
(And) Lead us not into temptation
But deliver us from evil
For Thine is the Kingdom and the Power and the Glory 
Forever and ever

Amen

14.title: Sai Gayathri
14.meaning:
Aum Sai is supreme divinity 

Sathya Sai is all One with Truth

That Truth is Light, for all to be divine
14.lyrics:
Aum Saayeeshvaraaya Vidhmahe

16.meaning: O Lord Sai! Illumine the temple of my mind so that the flame of knowledge may glow continuously. O Sai, the one with the effulgence of ten million suns, kindle the infinite flame of divinity, wisdom and Divine Love in my mind.

17.meaning: O Divine Mother, You are the nourisher and charmer of the Universe. You are the provider of lasting happiness and the destroyer of misfortune. You are known by several names, Parvathi, Bhairavi, Sambhavi, Gowri, Parameshwari and Bhuvaneshwari and presently You have incarnated as Mother Sai of Parthi.

Vishwa Vilasini Ma
Sthira Sukha Dayini Ma
Durgati Nashini Ma [ Jagadodharini Ma, Vishwa ... ]

Bhava Bhaya Harini Bhairavi Ma
Sambhavi Ma Gowri Ma
Jaya Parameshwari Jaya Bhuvaneshwari
Jaya Partheeshwari Parvathi Ma

35.title: Thought For The Day
35.om_shanthi_text: Why is love essential for the manifestation of God, and how can we keep the lamp of love burning bright? On the auspicious eve of Deepavali, Bhagawan lovingly reminds us today.
35.lyrics: Competition, the desire to defeat and overwhelm the other person by whatever means necessary for his downfall, and the greed to earn wealth, fame, superiority - these have put out the lamp of Love in the human heart today. Resolve on this Festival Day to light it again. When the worship of God starts in the shrine room, the first act of yours is ‘lighting a lamp’, isn’t it? Without a lit lamp, no auspicious ceremony is initiated. When the lamp of love is shining, God manifests! Keep it burning bright and pure, God persists! Allow all to light their lamps from it, God showers Grace! God, first; the world, next; myself last! That is the legitimate sequence for the sadhaka; and who is not a sadhaka? You have to be one, now or later, so that you can be liberated from this cycle of birth-death! Now, man, in his callousness towards his own welfare, has turned it topsy-turvy! It is ‘myself first, the world next and God is last.’ So, God is lost, too! Hold fast to God; then, you will be safe. You can hold fast to him, either through Jnana, Bhakti or Karma marga (paths of knowledge, worship or work).

38.title: Food Prayer - Brahmarpanam
38.meaning:
The act of offering is God. The offering is God.
By God it is offered into the Fire of God.
God is That which is to be attained by him
who performs action pertaining to God.
- Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 24

I reside as Vaishvanaro, the digestive power, in every living being.
I keep in balance the Prana (life breath) and Apana (downward moving air).
I digest and assimilate the four types of food partaken by every living being.
- Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 15, Verse 14
38.lyrics:
Brahmarpanam Brahmahavir
Brahmagnou Brahmanahutam
Brahmaivatena Gantavyam
Brahmakarma Samadhinaha
 

Aham Vaishvanaro Bhutva
Praninam Dehamashritaha
Pranapana Samayuktam
Pachamyannam Chaturvidham
